findings.passage: Free and fair elections are the foundation of our republic. I strongly support nationwide voter ID laws to ensure that only eligible citizens vote in American elections. I also support the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act, which requires proof of U.S. citizenship to register for federal elections and closes dangerous loopholes that could allow non-citizens onto voter rolls. These commonsense safeguards help restore confidence in our elections and ensure that America's future is decided by American citizens.
findings.note: Campaign issues page, section 'Protecting Election Integrity'. He states support for nationwide voter ID laws and for the SAVE Act. Date is the page's last-modified date (page first published 2026-03-05). The page's own text uses a curly apostrophe in 'America's'.
